**Joshua+ beta — making music at home.** First public beta. Expect rough edges and please [report problems](https://github.com/fabandrade88/joshuaplus/issues).

### Install

- **macOS / Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabandrade88/joshuaplus/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabandrade88/joshuaplus/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex`

The scripts verify every download against `SHA256SUMS`. The beta builds are not code-signed yet (see the README). Platforms: macOS on Apple Silicon (13.4+), Windows 10/11 x64, Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.39+). Intel Macs are not supported yet.

### What's in it

- Local stem separation: HT-Demucs 6-stem (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other), an instant DSP mode and an optional LALAL.AI cloud mode.
- Tempo and bar detection with a metronome locked to the song:
  - constant or variable tempo;
  - ×2 / ÷2, tap, or type the BPM;
  - 0–4 bars of count-in;
  - six click sounds.
- A mixer with volume, mute, solo and pan per track. The song's tracks can be collapsed into one.
- Bar map with auto-scroll, double-click bar loop and multi-bar loops.
- Folders as playlists that remember each song's settings, drag to reorder; album art and tags; rename songs.
- Up to 8 simultaneous audio inputs with meters and monitoring. MIDI and e-drum support for Alesis, Roland, Yamaha, EFNOTE, Simmons, Pearl, GEWA, ATV, Millenium and General MIDI kits.
- Recording: one take per armed input, lined up with the song automatically. Export the mix as a 24-bit WAV (the click only if it is on).
- Video studio: film yourself with the webcam over the music and your instruments (never the click), with YouTube, Shorts/Reels/TikTok and Instagram formats and an optional album cover, title and band overlay.
- Choose where the library lives (Music › Joshua+ is suggested), move it later, and pick a separate export folder.
- English, Português (Brasil) and Deutsch, plus a built-in "How to use" guide.
